concept: Why do sand dunes slowly march across the desert?
title: Marching Dunes
tagline: The desert walks when no one watches

science.hiddenLaw: Bagnold's law from mass conservation (Exner equation dh/dt = -1/rho_b * dq/dx): wind shear above saltation threshold drives saltation flux Q proportional to (tau - tau_c)^{3/2} that erodes the gentle stoss slope (dq/dx > 0) and deposits by grainfall and avalanching on the lee slipface at angle of repose (dq/dx < 0), so the dune form translates downwind with celerity c = Q / (rho_b * H) inversely proportional to dune height H.
science.plainStatement: Wind picks up sand on the gentle upwind side and drops it just over the crest onto the steep downwind slip face where it avalanches; grain by grain the whole shape creeps downwind, and short dunes creep faster than tall dunes because there is less sand to move through.
misconceptions: The wind pushes the whole dune forward like a solid block sliding on the ground from pressure drag.
Dunes wander randomly or migrate upwind toward the wind source.
Bigger and taller dunes move faster because they catch more wind.
Dunes move by rolling over like a wheel with sand tumbling underneath from front to back.

story.setting: One dune sits on a flat desert. In the midday sun you can see a long gentle slope facing the wind, and a short steep face where the sand slips.
story.mystery: Why does the whole dune creep downwind instead of blowing away?
story.goal: Discover how wind, slope and height set the dune's march.

checks.description: Control: with wind below saltation threshold the dune does not migrate - remove cause, effect disappears
With wind above threshold the crest displaces downwind (positive x) due to stoss erosion and lee deposition

Bagnold's law: under the same wind, a dune twice as tall migrates about half as fast (c proportional to 1/H). At wind 8 a height-10 dune walks about 0.60 dune widths per 10,000 steps, so a height-20 dune should walk about 0.30.
Mass conservation: stoss slope shows net erosion (negative height change) while lee slipface shows deposition when wind blows
